text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um...! Happy birthday! I made some cream 
puffs, so please take some if you'd 
like...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-If it's a bother, I'm so sorry...! But 
you've done so much for me, so...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Um, when Rice was feeling down, 
you gave me a push forward, and..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Like taking me to the infirmary when I got 
hurt in a mock race...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She lent me an umbrella when I got caught 
in the rain outside, too... And so many 
other things...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...... Cream puffs over something like 
that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Truth is, I messed up a few 
times... But this one turned out really 
well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-T-T-Taishin-san, you don't like sweets, 
right...!? I-I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry, 
please forget I said anything...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I was kind of in the mood for something 
sweet just now anyway.
